existing_public_supplier.exact_header:
theorem materialE0_rpow_le_of_exponent_le
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    {A B : ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo D.a D.b, T.E0 r ^ A ≤ K * T.E0 r ^ B
existing_public_supplier.proof_basis: Exact endpoint formulas imply E0>=1 on both endpoint collars. The continuous negative-power ratio is bounded on the compact middle interval. The complete proof was read; no local primitive/transport bound is an input.

specialization.result: exists K : Real, 0 <= K and forall r in radialCore D, 1 <= K * T.E0 r
specialization.dependencies: Only the original hT. K is selected before z, piece index, and physical point.

common_constant_construction.derivative_input: For the fixed z, the previously derived common envelope gives Cd(z)>0 and q jets0..2/tau jets1..2 <= Cd(z)*T.M(p.1) on every reference open piece.
common_constant_construction.ratio_input: The actual hdisp+hwindow argument gives the two required H/M ratios <= Real.exp1 on every reference open piece, on one neighborhood chosen before states.
common_constant_construction.choose: A := (1 : Real); C0 := Cd(z) + Real.exp(1) * K
common_constant_construction.positivity: Cd(z)>0, exp1>0 and K>=0 imply C0>0; 0<=A.
common_constant_construction.uniformity: Same A=1 and C0 for all four transport fields, every piece, point and requested derivative order. Only Cd and hence C0 may depend on the already-fixed state z; K depends solely on hT.

one_power_assessment.exact_quantifiers: hf : forall delta>0, exists C>0, forall m, |f m|<=C*M(sample(K.cell m))^delta; output exists C>0, forall m, |f m|<=C*M(sample(K.cell m)).
one_power_assessment.adding_constant_one: Valid using N07aSampleSubpower.const/add. Combined with the same-piece ratio envelope and cancellation, this also yields1<=C*M(p) on each reference open piece.
one_power_assessment.why_not_sufficient_alone: The last two actual transport fields use E0^A, not M^A. A lower bound for M cannot raise their E0 exponent from0 to1. Use the existing public exponent-monotonicity supplier above.
